title: Leaking globals
description:
These two functions give the right answers, but every variable inside them is accidentally global: after one call, `total`, `count`, `best` and the others are visible to the whole program, and a second function using the same names would trample them.

Fix them so that the only globals they create are the two functions themselves.

starter.solution.lua:
function average(list)
    total = 0
    for i = 1, #list do
        value = list[i]
        total = total + value
    end
    count = #list
    return total / count
end

function longest_word(words)
    best = ""
    for _, w in ipairs(words) do
        size = #w
        if size > #best then best = w end
    end
    return best
end

solution.solution.lua:
function average(list)
    local total = 0
    for i = 1, #list do
        local value = list[i]
        total = total + value
    end
    local count = #list
    return total / count
end

function longest_word(words)
    local best = ""
    for _, w in ipairs(words) do
        local size = #w
        if size > #best then best = w end
    end
    return best
end

hints: Every variable is introduced with `local` the first time it is assigned. A `for` loop's variables are local already.
unitTests:
local function globals()
    local names = {}
    for k in pairs(_G) do names[k] = true end
    return names
end

local function new_globals(before)
    local found = {}
    for k in pairs(_G) do
        if not before[k] then found[#found + 1] = k end
    end
    table.sort(found)
    return found
end

-- The leak checks come first, before any other test has called the functions.
test("average leaves no globals behind", function()
    local before = globals()
    average({ 1, 2, 3 })
    check_eq(new_globals(before), {}, "new global variables after calling average")
end)

test("longest_word leaves no globals behind", function()
    local before = globals()
    longest_word({ "x", "yy" })
    check_eq(new_globals(before), {}, "new global variables after calling longest_word")
end)

test("the answers are right", function()
    check_eq(average({ 2, 4, 9 }), 5.0)
    check_eq(longest_word({ "a", "lua", "be", "moon" }), "moon")
    check_eq(longest_word({}), "")
    for _, name in ipairs({ "total", "value", "count", "best", "size" }) do
        check(rawget(_G, name) == nil, "there is a global called " .. name)
    end
end)
